# Selected public DSH Office provider

Seven MIT helper files come from public DeepSeek Harness
[d743267388641bc76f17c45ce8b4c231aed1d32c](https://github.com/deepseek-ai/deepseek-harness/tree/d743267388641bc76f17c45ce8b4c231aed1d32c).
The original MIT licence remains in LICENSE. SOURCE.json records original paths,
source and adapted SHA-256 values, and explicit changes.

The original provider, bounded queue, regular complete-PDF validator, errors,
identities and branded primitives remain in use. Local NodeNext imports and a
Pi lifecycle/authorized byte-reader seat replace Cordis, schema/decorator wiring
and its filesystem service. The optional backend-owned scratch seat establishes
cleanup before source copying and awaits release before slot reuse; backends
without it keep the original temporary-directory behavior. Queue/provider cleanup state is exposed to Pi
maintenance; engine font disk caching is disabled. No supplier service Host,
tool/Session/model owner or second agent loop is copied.

The separately pinned LibreOffice kit and Linux Wasm engine are MPL-2.0, with
their own third-party/source/rebuild notices. These are not covered by this MIT
notice. Private source/ordinary/installed and public-distribution qualifications
are separate; read [Office preview contracts and evidence](../../../../docs/HARNESS-OFFICE-PREVIEWS.md).
